rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight accomplishments
compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulaṃ (root Kaula)

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula in relation to the attainment of the eight siddhis?
premises: The eight accomplishments are under consideration.
The attainment of these siddhis is identified with the root Kaula.
This teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis is itself the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation within the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is inferred from sandhi and context.
items.plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula.
